source: Existing public Formula SAE hero photograph

masks.use: Default: laptops and desktops wider than 1140px (the two hero text links sit on a second row under the button, on the white side of the fade).

721-1140px wide (except tall tablets 721-1100px at 900px+ high): the copy and single CTA row reach the car's front corner. Axis-aligned SVG feathers read as a rectangular asphalt slab at 1024x768 and 1100x800, so this band uses a hull-based fall-off instead.
masks.format: 1100x619 PNG (white + 8-bit alpha), the 2200x1238 photo frame at half scale; same aspect, so mask-size: cover and mask-position line up with the photo exactly as the SVG masks do.
masks.method: Alpha 255 inside one broad convex hull around the car, driver and roll hoop (photo coordinates below) plus a margin, then a Gaussian fall-off with distance from the hull. Sigma is short (sigS) inside the copy/CTA corner box left of and below the nose and above the hoop, long (sigB) elsewhere, blended with smoothsteps; alpha reaches 0 before the photo's last row. The hull is one continuous region, not component contours, and has no holes.
masks.pairedCss: Background layer in the same band: opacity .9, no filter (elsewhere .82 / saturate(.97)).

masks.use: Tablets 721-1100px wide and at least 900px tall, where the copy and CTAs sit well below the car.
Phones (720px and below), where the tagline starts just below the car.

method: Same two overlapping continuous original-photo regions as the 2026-10-13 mask. The car region feathers outward from its left, bottom and (except the compact mask) right edges with a Gaussian fall-off (truncated at 3 sigma, ending inside the photo). The top ramp and the driver region are unchanged from 2026-10-13. No individual component outlines or holes.
purpose: Soften the rectangular 'asphalt slab' edge left of, below and right of the car (audit H10/rec 8: 140-180 CSS px feather at 1440) while preserving the original suspension links, chassis, driver, wheels, gaps and source contact shadows without part-by-part clipping. Narrower layouts keep shorter left/bottom feathers so the hero copy and CTAs keep at least 4.5:1 contrast.
validation: Chrome canvas raster check for all four masks: minimum alpha 255 inside both protected regions; alpha 0 on the photo's last row and first column. Hero text-link contrast measured against the photo with the text hidden (median, 10th percentile) at 768-2560px widths: every link and arrow has p10 >= 5.5:1 at widths of 1024px and above. Source photo pixels and the 2026-10-13 mask are unchanged. Band PNG: alpha 255 everywhere inside the hull; alpha 0 on the first and last columns and the last row. Hero link/copy contrast (p10, text hidden) at 1024x768, 1100x800, 1112x834, 1133x744 and 1140x800 was measured for every link (e.g. Resume link 1024x768: 6.3:1).
limits: Region coordinates are photo presentation coordinates, not vehicle dimensions or engineering measurements. No generated/reconstructed parts or sharpening. Only mask alpha changed; the CSS background layer moved from opacity .78/saturate .94 to .82/.97 (.9/no filter in the 721-1140px band).
